apps.description: Document repositories create a central, structured, and reliable knowledge base for the AI that models can access contextually.

DocumentRepositoryListTable.emptyDescription: No document repositories have been created yet.

DocumentRepositoryEditor.confirmDeleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the document repository "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

DocumentRepositoryEditorDiscardAllChange.labelDiscardConfirm: Do you really want to discard all unsaved changes to this document repository?

DocumentRepositoryEditorOverview.emptyDescription: Define the behavior and appearance of the document repository.
DocumentRepositoryEditorOverview.checklistSemanticSearchDescription: Enable semantic search. This can improve the quality of search results.
DocumentRepositoryEditorOverview.checklistTranscriberDescription: Select a transcriber that automatically transcribes all uploaded video and audio files.
DocumentRepositoryEditorOverview.helpKeywordSearch: Classic keyword search. Best suited for searching brand, person, and other names.
DocumentRepositoryEditorOverview.helpEmbeddingDescription: Add an embedding model to enable semantic search. It finds similar documents based on their semantics.
DocumentRepositoryEditorOverview.helpTranscriberDescription: Add a transcriber to the document repository and all video and audio files are transcribed automatically after upload.

DocumentRepositoryEditorFeaturesIndex.description: Depending on the search index, different methods are used to provide the best results based on the search query.
DocumentRepositoryEditorFeaturesIndex.descriptionKeyword: When searching for precise expressions and sentences. (Names, designations, etc.)
DocumentRepositoryEditorFeaturesIndex.descriptionSemantic: When the semantics of the data are in the foreground and not the exact wording. (Requires an embedding model)
DocumentRepositoryEditorFeaturesIndex.descriptionEmbeddingModel: The embedding model is the basis for semantic search.

DocumentRepositoryEditorFeaturesTranscri.description: Video and audio files are transcribed automatically after upload.

DocumentRepositoryEditorSettingsDescript.description: Choose a suitable name for the document repository. In addition, a short description can also be saved.

DocumentRepositoryEditorSettingsAppearan.description: Determine a color and an icon that best represent the document repository.

DocumentRepositoryEditorSettingsWorkspac.description: Select the workspace in which the document repository should be created.

Search.emptyDescription: Search text within all files in this document repository.

page.emptyDescription: No document repositories have been created yet.
page.helpSearchDescription: You can search for document repositories. The search includes, among other things, the name and description of the document repository, as well as its transcriber.
page.helpSortDescription: Document repositories can be sorted by name. They can be sorted into different groups. Document repositories can be displayed as cards or as a table.
page.helpTranscriberDescription: You can select a transcriber for document repositories. When audio or video files are uploaded to the document repository, they are transcribed automatically.
